# Answer to `generator-shortcuts`

The strongest plausible rival is:

> Sort the two object colors numerically from left to right, placing the larger
> color on the left and the smaller color on the right, while preserving both
> shapes and positions.

This fits all three labeled canonical pairs because every canonical input has
the lower-valued color on the left and higher-valued color on the right, so the
canonical color swap produces descending left-to-right colors.

## Exact disagreement

The repaired generator emits this case with `seed=9`, `sample_index=1`, and
`grid_h=7, grid_w=9, shape_pair=0, color_pair=0`:

Input:

```text
000001100
000000100
220000000
020000000
000000000
000000000
000000000
```

Intended color exchange:

```text
000002200
000000200
110000000
010000000
000000000
000000000
000000000
```

Descending-color rival:

```text
000001100
000000100
220000000
020000000
000000000
000000000
000000000
```

The rival leaves this input unchanged because color 2 is already on the left;
the intended rule swaps the two colors.

## How it was checked

1. A source-bound Python probe checked that `sort_colors_descending` fits all
   3/3 labeled canonical pairs.
2. An independent connected-component oracle computed the intended swap and
   found six cells where the rival differs.
3. `arcpuzzles apply` independently executed the selected Racket authority on
   the exact input with generator-domain checking enabled. Its output matched
   the independent oracle, differed from the rival, and reported matching
   executed/catalog rule hashes `57cc84264d9e`.
4. Portable regression tests cover the same canonical fit and generated
   counterexample.

Evidence: `checks/repair-counterexample/python_probe.json`,
`checks/repair-counterexample/racket_apply.json`, and
`checks/repair-counterexample/input.json`.

## Does the proposed generator emit such cases?

Yes. Even `sample_index` puts the lower color on the left; odd `sample_index`
puts the higher color on the left. The semantic smoke test observed the
left-color-greater witness in 294/600 ordinary draws. A larger census
materialized 300 lessons with three demonstrations and one query each; all 300
production lessons and all 1,200 held-out query rotations refuted the declared
rival with zero ambiguity or scoring errors.
